input.summary: Genotype/phenotype sanity (zebrafish proxy data only). p2/p3 (fin length/span/area ratios up): no gene in the digest maps to an INCREASE; the fin-size genes are loss-of-function (necessity) only. p4/p2 (flight_muscle_fraction 0.012->0.04): mib1 and pax7a touch pectoral fin muscle, but only as presence/patterning, not a quantitative fraction. No edits.

findings.phenotype_change: pectoral length, span, area ratios up to flying-fish reference (borrowed from the flying-fish reference) plus flight_muscle_fraction 0.04 (assumed placeholder)

genes.note: loss gives absent/reduced fin, proximodistal truncation
loss gives small fin, short cleithrum
no bud / truncated fin at reduced dose
small or hypoplastic fin; chains necessity (wls: hypothesis)

fin_size_part.caveat: All are loss-of-function, so they show a gene is needed for fin size, not that changing it enlarges the fin. Only kcnh2a and kcnk5b carry a sufficiency-grade chain (best mechanism, weakest sufficiency), but the digest gives them an empty phenotype string, so I cannot map them to fin length/span/area without inventing; I make no claim for them.

findings.phenotype_change: pectoral span/SL and area/SL^2 up on both fins (borrowed from flying-fish reference)
findings.maps: same as p2 fin-size part: loss-of-function size genes only (fgf10a, shha, extl3, tbx5a, tbx5b, prdm1a, sox9a, lama5), all necessity-grade or weaker; no digest gene supports a gain in span or area. Not a mapping to any one gene.

genes.note: strongest chain, but the digest gives no direction or size of effect
presence vs absence of fin muscle, not a fraction
primary phenotype is myoblast fusion; girdle bone secondary; does not explain muscle fraction
pectoral fin only, no fetched source for a link

findings.caveat: No digest gene maps to a quantitative increase in flight muscle fraction. The 0.04 value is an assumed placeholder, not a result.

findings.overall: The digest is zebrafish proxy data. It supports which genes are required for fin and fin-muscle formation, not the proposed quantitative increases. Genes for mineralisation (enpp1, sp7, bmp1a), neural wiring (foxc1a) and girdle asymmetry (meox1) do not map to any proposal. No bird data used. Lean/scenario results from other agents are floating-point and not re-checked here.
